mindfulness and CD do not have the same effect on eudaimonic functioning.

the mindfulness of the moment and CD are separate variables that are independent of each other, but that they are positively correlated with the satisfaction of basic human needs.

a specific type of time perspective, which is not included in the most commonly used models, namely the Carpe Diam time perspective.
the need for the inclusion of the temporal perspective in mindfulness studies, and the need for the specification of the nature of mindfulness in relation to similar constructs.
the need to specify the construct of mindfulness, which has not yet been sufficiently developed.

the more mindfulness and Carpe Diem are present in a person, the higher their eudaimonic functioning.

the mindfulness of time perspective (MTP) is a multidimensional construct that includes mindfulness and CD.

mindfulness, as a form of awareness, is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a positive attitude to the present moment.
a combination of CD and mindfulness is a good recipe for the pursuit of a good life.

we should not only focus on the present but also on the future, and the future should be perceived in the right way.
